description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: is my endpoint payable by a default x402 client? Check an x402 endpoint before paying it — read the 402 challenge, verify accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), check the input example for placeholders, and measure the challenge against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use before listing a new API, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
